label: managerial or political leadership in
definition: Person 1 holds or formerly held a managerial or political leadership office in organization/body 2.
scope_notes: Head, president, leader, chair, executive, manager, director and chief qualify. Founder, generic employee, coach or organizational subsidiary alone does not. Historical offices qualify.

facts.reason: Bruno is explicitly leader of/in the State Senate and its majority, including reelection as leader.
Kozlowski is explicitly executive, chairman and head of Tyco International, with historical resignation evidence.
Democrats elected to the Senate establishes election/membership, not a leadership office in that body.
The direct Senate-leader title establishes Lott holding a leadership role in the Senate.
The rows mix Eagles and Super Bowl under one entity pair and describe a trade and a championship result; neither expresses a person holding managerial office.
